Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
A simple (bare-bones) macOS menubar extra to apply display presets.

repo_meta_data.description: Free, open-source external monitor control for macOS: a lightweight menu bar app with sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness, presets, and virtual displays. A free alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar, including features they charge for.
